products.name: InternLM (Shanghai AI Lab)
products.note: Chinese open-source LLM; academic research; cross-border data review advised

reading.body:
Shanghai AI Laboratory is a government-affiliated research institution in China operating InternLM, an open-source large language model positioned for academic research across Chinese universities and scientific applications.

The laboratory's stated focus spans model capability, embodied robotics, and AI safety frameworks, with recent emphasis on science-oriented systems that integrate language models, specialist agents, and physical automation. This portfolio suggests a research strategy prioritizing broad capability development rather than any single domain constraint. The 2026 announcement of AI-for-science results and a scientific discovery platform indicates the institution is testing large models as infrastructure for experimental workflows, from hypothesis through validation.

What matters for AI infrastructure is that Shanghai AI Laboratory operates within China's university and research ecosystem, not as a commercial infrastructure builder or power provider. The laboratory contributes to model capability and research methodology but does not control the compute, buildings, or power grids that determine how quickly those capabilities can scale. It represents the downstream user of infrastructure, not the constraint that binds it.

The data does not cover the laboratory's budget, its access to compute hardware, or the power requirements of its training and inference systems. Without those facts, the connection between its research ambitions and the infrastructure constraints that may or may not enable them remains unmeasured.

profile_text.body:
Shanghai AI Laboratory is a non-profit government laboratory. Its website presents it as a research institution recruiting global talent in areas including artificial intelligence, large models, embodied intelligence, safe and trustworthy AI, AI for Science, foundational platforms, and management support. Since 2022 it has run a joint doctoral training program with Peking University, Tsinghua University, Fudan University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Tongji University, University of Science and Technology of China, Zhejiang University, and other universities. The site describes releases such as a scientific discovery platform called 书生 Duanyan, the 书生 physical world model W0, and the 书生 embodied full-stack engine Intern-Robotics. It also describes an AI safety approach based on a 45-degree balance between safety and performance and a causal path of general alignment, intervention, and reflection.

The available data lists one product, InternLM, a Chinese open-source large language model associated with academic research, with a note that cross-border data review is advised. The website also describes the 书生 line of models and platforms, including the Duanyan scientific discovery platform and Intern-Robotics, as well as ten joint scientific intelligence achievements in life sciences, materials science, and deep space astronomy announced at the 2026 WAIC science frontier forum.

No litigation or MCP server entries are associated with Shanghai AI Laboratory in the available data. The site's 2026 recruitment materials include a "Polaris" talent plan and global campus hiring for roles in AI, large models, embodied intelligence, trustworthy AI, swarm intelligence, and AI for Science.
